reviewer: ChatGPT GPT-6 (AI technical audit; NOT an independent human reviewer)
scope: 40-case SQL benchmark v3 only: business wording, Gold SQL, Gold Results, behavior label, discriminative quality; not SQL Agent code audit
evidence: Earlier in this conversation all 30 queries were independently re-executed read-only on Supabase and 404/404 saved output rows matched. Current review reconfirmed live population counts: 3300 orders, 5749 order items, 174 returns, 4559 inventory rows and 47 inventory snapshots. Stored mutation-probe report: 23/26 valid executed mutations detected.

review_cases.question: Tổng số sessions theo từng tháng và traffic_source trong năm 2024.
review_cases.gold_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', w.date)::date AS month, w.traffic_source, SUM(w.sessions) AS sessions FROM commerce.web_traffic AS w WHERE w.date >= $1 AND w.date < $2 GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', w.date)::date, w.traffic_source ORDER BY month ASC, w.traffic_source ASC LIMIT 200
review_cases.reason: Month × traffic_source SUM(sessions) uses the correct date grain. 48 rows.

review_cases.question: Thời gian giao hàng trung bình theo tháng gửi trong năm 2025, chỉ tính shipment đã có delivery_date; cho biết thêm số shipment thiếu delivery_date theo từng tháng.
review_cases.gold_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', s.ship_date)::date AS month, AVG(s.delivery_date - s.ship_date) FILTER (WHERE s.delivery_date IS NOT NULL) AS average_delivery_days, COUNT(s.delivery_date) AS completed_shipment_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.delivery_date IS NULL) AS missing_delivery_date_count FROM commerce.shipments AS s WHERE s.ship_date >= $1 AND s.ship_date < $2 GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', s.ship_date)::date ORDER BY month ASC LIMIT 200
review_cases.reason: REVISE wording or output contract: Gold adds completed_shipment_count (the average denominator), while the question explicitly requests mean duration and missing delivery-date count. This extra column must be explicitly requested or explicitly allowed.

review_cases.question: Trong các tháng có return record, có bao nhiêu return record mỗi tháng năm 2025, tính theo return_date?
review_cases.gold_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', r.return_date)::date AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT r.return_id) AS return_count FROM commerce.returns AS r WHERE r.return_date >= $1 AND r.return_date < $2 GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', r.return_date)::date ORDER BY month ASC LIMIT 12
review_cases.reason: Only months containing return records are required. 11 rows, correct count(DISTINCT return_id).

review_cases.question: Giá trị đơn hàng trung bình theo tháng trong năm 2025, chỉ tính đơn đã giao.
review_cases.gold_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date)::date AS month, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0) AS average_order_value FROM commerce.orders AS o JOIN commerce.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status = $1 AND o.order_date >= $2 AND o.order_date < $3 GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date)::date ORDER BY month ASC LIMIT 12
review_cases.reason: AOV = SUM(quantity*unit_price-discount_amount)/COUNT(DISTINCT delivered order_id); uses 2025 order_date. Confirm this declared business AOV policy as part of human sign-off.

review_cases.question: Tháng nào có tổng refund_amount cao nhất trong 6 tháng đầu năm 2024? Nếu bằng nhau, chọn tháng sớm hơn.
review_cases.gold_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', r.return_date)::date AS month, SUM(r.refund_amount) AS refund_amount FROM commerce.returns AS r WHERE r.return_date >= $1 AND r.return_date < $2 GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', r.return_date)::date ORDER BY refund_amount DESC, month ASC LIMIT 1
review_cases.reason: Largest monthly sum(refund_amount) in Jan-Jun 2024 with earlier-month tie-break. Gold May 2024, 35611.25.

review_cases.question: Trong năm 2024, có bao nhiêu khách hàng đăng ký có profile ZIP ánh xạ đến thành phố Hai Phong và age_group là 25-34?
review_cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS customer_count FROM commerce.customers AS c JOIN commerce.geography AS g ON g.zip = c.zip WHERE g.city = $1 AND c.age_group = $2 AND c.signup_date >= $3 AND c.signup_date < $4 LIMIT 1
review_cases.reason: REVISE stale required_metric_or_intent: says 'profile region and non-NULL age_group', but v3 question and SQL correctly filter profile ZIP city='Hai Phong' AND age_group='25-34'. Gold count 17.

review_cases.question: Trong năm 2024, tổng revenue và COGS của những ngày có COGS lớn hơn revenue là bao nhiêu?
review_cases.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(s.revenue) AS revenue, SUM(s.cogs) AS cogs FROM commerce.sales AS s WHERE s.date >= $1 AND s.date < $2 AND s.cogs > s.revenue LIMIT 1
review_cases.reason: The cogs>revenue test is applied per daily sales row BEFORE summation, not to yearly totals. 20 qualifying 2024 rows.

review_cases.question: Tổng refund_amount theo từng return_reason trong năm 2024, chỉ tính return_reason không NULL.
review_cases.gold_sql: SELECT r.return_reason, SUM(r.refund_amount) AS refund_amount FROM commerce.returns AS r WHERE r.return_date >= $1 AND r.return_date < $2 AND r.return_reason IS NOT NULL GROUP BY r.return_reason ORDER BY refund_amount DESC, r.return_reason ASC LIMIT 200
review_cases.reason: Gold sums refund by non-NULL reason correctly, but removal of IS NOT NULL is observationally equivalent in 2024; the limitation must be disclosed.

review_cases.question: Tổng inventory.units_sold cho category Outdoor tại snapshot 2025-10-31.
review_cases.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(i.units_sold) AS units_sold FROM commerce.inventory AS i WHERE i.snapshot_date = $1 AND i.category = $2 LIMIT 1
review_cases.reason: Inventory units_sold at exact 2025-10-31 Outdoor snapshot, not transaction quantities. Gold 113.

review_cases.question: Trong năm 2025, có bao nhiêu đơn từ paid_search được đặt trên thiết bị mobile?
review_cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count FROM commerce.orders AS o WHERE o.order_date >= $1 AND o.order_date < $2 AND o.order_source = $3 AND o.device_type = $4 LIMIT 1
review_cases.reason: Both paid_search and mobile filters apply to 2025 orders. Gold 20.

review_cases.question: Rank the five products with the highest catalog COGS; return product_id and catalog cogs, ties by product_id ascending.
review_cases.gold_sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.cogs AS catalog_cogs FROM commerce.products AS p ORDER BY catalog_cogs DESC, p.product_id ASC LIMIT 5
review_cases.reason: Catalog products.cogs ranking, not realized transaction-level COGS; 5 products, deterministic product_id tie-break.

review_cases.question: Xếp hạng order_source theo số đơn hàng trong năm 2024, tính mọi trạng thái; nếu bằng nhau sắp order_source tăng dần.
review_cases.gold_sql: SELECT o.order_source, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count FROM commerce.orders AS o WHERE o.order_date >= $1 AND o.order_date < $2 GROUP BY o.order_source ORDER BY order_count DESC, o.order_source ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 200
review_cases.reason: All order statuses included; ranks order_source by distinct count, deterministic tie-break.

review_cases.question: Tại snapshot 2026-11-13, top 5 segment theo tổng units_received; nếu bằng nhau sắp segment tăng dần.
review_cases.gold_sql: SELECT i.segment, SUM(i.units_received) AS units_received FROM commerce.inventory AS i WHERE i.snapshot_date = $1 GROUP BY i.segment ORDER BY units_received DESC, i.segment ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 5
review_cases.reason: Snapshot-stored segment, sum units_received on 2026-11-13, TOP 5.

review_cases.question: Which destination cities had the most distinct customers with a delivered order in 2024? Return the top 5, ties by city ascending.
review_cases.gold_sql: SELECT g.city, COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS customer_count FROM commerce.orders AS o JOIN commerce.geography AS g ON g.zip = o.zip WHERE o.order_status = $1 AND o.order_date >= $2 AND o.order_date < $3 GROUP BY g.city ORDER BY customer_count DESC, g.city ASC LIMIT 5
review_cases.reason: Delivered orders in 2024, destination ZIP -> geography.city, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id), TOP 5.

review_cases.question: Top 3 danh mục theo doanh thu dòng hàng sau discount_amount của các đơn đã giao trong năm 2025.
review_cases.gold_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) AS net_revenue FROM commerce.orders AS o JOIN commerce.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN commerce.products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.order_status = $1 AND o.order_date >= $2 AND o.order_date < $3 GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY net_revenue DESC, p.category ASC LIMIT 3
review_cases.reason: Delivered 2025 item net amount after discount, current product category, TOP 3 among four categories.

review_cases.question: Tổng return_quantity theo thành phố giao của đơn trong năm 2025, tính theo return_date.
review_cases.gold_sql: SELECT g.city, SUM(r.return_quantity) AS returned_units FROM commerce.returns AS r JOIN commerce.orders AS o ON o.order_id = r.order_id JOIN commerce.geography AS g ON g.zip = o.zip WHERE r.return_date >= $1 AND r.return_date < $2 GROUP BY g.city ORDER BY returned_units DESC, g.city ASC LIMIT 200
review_cases.reason: Returns filtered by return_date in 2025, joined returns->orders->geography using order destination ZIP. 14 cities.

review_cases.question: Tổng số lượng hàng trả theo product_id từ năm 2023 đến hết năm 2025, tính theo return_date.
review_cases.gold_sql: SELECT r.product_id, SUM(r.return_quantity) AS returned_units FROM commerce.returns AS r WHERE r.return_date >= $1 AND r.return_date < $2 GROUP BY r.product_id ORDER BY returned_units DESC, r.product_id ASC LIMIT 200
review_cases.reason: REVISE stale required_metric_or_intent text ('by product and return-date year'): SQL groups only by product_id, as the question requests, across 2023–2025. Fix metadata; Gold 60 product groups.

review_cases.question: Điểm đánh giá trung bình theo category hiện tại của sản phẩm, dùng toàn bộ review history.
review_cases.gold_sql: SELECT p.category, AVG(r.rating) AS avg_rating FROM commerce.reviews AS r JOIN commerce.products AS p ON p.product_id = r.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY avg_rating DESC, p.category ASC LIMIT 200
review_cases.reason: AVG(rating) over all review history, joined to current category, as requested.

review_cases.question: Tổng payment_value đã ghi nhận theo payment_method cho các đơn có order_date trong năm 2025.
review_cases.gold_sql: SELECT p.payment_method, SUM(p.payment_value) AS payment_value FROM commerce.orders AS o JOIN commerce.payments AS p ON p.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_date >= $1 AND o.order_date < $2 GROUP BY p.payment_method ORDER BY payment_value DESC, p.payment_method ASC LIMIT 200
review_cases.reason: Join recorded payments to orders, filter by 2025 order_date, use payments.payment_method, not orders.payment_method.

review_cases.question: Phí shipping trung bình theo thành phố giao hàng, cho các shipment có ship_date trong năm 2025; báo thêm số phí không NULL.
review_cases.gold_sql: SELECT g.city, AVG(s.shipping_fee) AS average_shipping_fee, COUNT(s.shipping_fee) AS fee_observation_count FROM commerce.shipments AS s JOIN commerce.orders AS o ON o.order_id = s.order_id JOIN commerce.geography AS g ON g.zip = o.zip WHERE s.ship_date >= $1 AND s.ship_date < $2 GROUP BY g.city ORDER BY average_shipping_fee DESC NULLS LAST, g.city ASC LIMIT 200
review_cases.reason: AVG(shipping_fee) by destination city, 2025 ship_date, COUNT(non-NULL fees); all 728 source fees are non-NULL, so NULL-fee sensitivity not exercised.

review_cases.question: Tại snapshot 2026-11-13, đếm số sản phẩm có stockout_flag = TRUE theo từng category.
review_cases.gold_sql: SELECT i.category, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.stockout_flag = TRUE) AS stockout_product_count, COUNT(DISTINCT i.product_id) AS observed_product_count FROM commerce.inventory AS i WHERE i.snapshot_date = $1 GROUP BY i.category ORDER BY stockout_product_count DESC, i.category ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 200
review_cases.reason: REVISE mismatch: Gold returns observed_product_count alongside stockout_product_count, but question does not request observed-product denominator. Add it to wording or explicitly allow it in output policy.

review_cases.question: Theo từng snapshot tồn kho từ 2023-01-31 đến 2026-11-13, đếm số product có và không có days_of_supply; giữ NULL riêng, không thay bằng 0.
review_cases.gold_sql: SELECT i.snapshot_date, COUNT(i.days_of_supply) AS products_with_days_of_supply, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.days_of_supply IS NULL) AS products_without_days_of_supply FROM commerce.inventory AS i WHERE i.snapshot_date >= $1 AND i.snapshot_date <= $2 GROUP BY i.snapshot_date ORDER BY i.snapshot_date ASC LIMIT 100
review_cases.reason: Per snapshot counts of non-NULL and NULL days_of_supply across 47 snapshots; NULL is not coerced to zero.

review_cases.question: So sánh stock_on_hand của các product_id xuất hiện ở cả snapshot 2025-09-30 và 2025-10-31; trả về before, after và after trừ before.
review_cases.gold_sql: SELECT i.product_id, MAX(i.stock_on_hand) FILTER (WHERE i.snapshot_date = $1) AS stock_before, MAX(i.stock_on_hand) FILTER (WHERE i.snapshot_date = $2) AS stock_after, MAX(i.stock_on_hand) FILTER (WHERE i.snapshot_date = $2) - MAX(i.stock_on_hand) FILTER (WHERE i.snapshot_date = $1) AS stock_delta FROM commerce.inventory AS i WHERE i.snapshot_date = $1 OR i.snapshot_date = $2 GROUP BY i.product_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT i.snapshot_date) = 2 ORDER BY stock_delta DESC, i.product_id ASC LIMIT 200
review_cases.reason: Both-date membership enforced; stock_delta is after-before. All 97 products exist on both snapshots, so omitting membership HAVING is observationally equivalent.

review_cases.question: Tổng stock_on_hand tại từng snapshot từ 2025-09-30 đến 2025-11-30; giữ mỗi snapshot thành một dòng và không cộng số dư giữa các ngày.
review_cases.gold_sql: SELECT i.snapshot_date, SUM(i.stock_on_hand) AS observed_stock_total, COUNT(DISTINCT i.product_id) AS observed_products FROM commerce.inventory AS i WHERE i.snapshot_date >= $1 AND i.snapshot_date <= $2 GROUP BY i.snapshot_date ORDER BY i.snapshot_date ASC LIMIT 100
review_cases.reason: REVISE mismatch: Gold also returns observed_products alongside requested per-snapshot stock total; update question or output policy. Never sum stock across dates.

review_cases.question: Tại snapshot 2025-10-31, tính trung bình days_of_supply theo category được ghi trong inventory row; báo số non-NULL và NULL, không thay NULL bằng 0.
review_cases.gold_sql: SELECT i.category, AVG(i.days_of_supply) AS average_days_of_supply, COUNT(i.days_of_supply) AS nonnull_product_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.days_of_supply IS NULL) AS null_product_count FROM commerce.inventory AS i WHERE i.snapshot_date = $1 GROUP BY i.category ORDER BY average_days_of_supply DESC NULLS LAST, i.category ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 200
review_cases.reason: AVG(days_of_supply) remains NULL for all four categories at 2025-10-31, with observed/NULL counts; correct NULL semantics.

review_cases.question: Hãy trình bày theo từng tháng.
review_cases.gold_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', s.date)::date AS month, SUM(s.cogs) AS cogs FROM commerce.sales AS s WHERE s.date >= $1 AND s.date < $2 GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', s.date)::date ORDER BY month ASC LIMIT 12
review_cases.reason: Uses approved frozen prior-question context: company COGS in 2024, grouped by month. This tests context-conditioned SQL only, not full conversation memory.

review_cases.question: Với thống kê order_source vừa rồi, chỉ giữ các đơn đã giao.
review_cases.gold_sql: SELECT o.order_source, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count FROM commerce.orders AS o WHERE o.order_status = $1 AND o.order_date >= $2 AND o.order_date < $3 GROUP BY o.order_source ORDER BY order_count DESC, o.order_source ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 200
review_cases.reason: Uses inherited year 2025, preserves order_source grouping, filters delivered. Counts 719 delivered of 733 orders; omission of delivered is detectable.

review_cases.question: Còn so với năm trước theo từng tháng thì sao?
review_cases.gold_sql: WITH monthly AS (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.date) AS sales_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.date) AS month, SUM(s.revenue) - SUM(s.cogs) AS gross_profit FROM commerce.sales AS s WHERE s.date >= $1 AND s.date < $2 GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.date), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.date)) SELECT m.month, MAX(m.gross_profit) FILTER (WHERE m.sales_year = 2023) AS gross_profit_2023, MAX(m.gross_profit) FILTER (WHERE m.sales_year = 2024) AS gross_profit_2024, MAX(m.gross_profit) FILTER (WHERE m.sales_year = 2024) - MAX(m.gross_profit) FILTER (WHERE m.sales_year = 2023) AS difference_2024_minus_2023 FROM monthly AS m GROUP BY m.month ORDER BY m.month ASC LIMIT 12
review_cases.reason: Pairs 2023 and 2024 same calendar month, computes SUM(revenue)-SUM(cogs) and year-to-year difference; 12 monthly output rows, correct.

review_cases.question: Trong bảng xếp hạng vừa rồi, chỉ hiện top 2; nếu hòa, xếp tên reason tăng dần.
review_cases.gold_sql: SELECT r.return_reason, SUM(r.return_quantity) AS returned_units FROM commerce.returns AS r WHERE r.return_date >= $1 AND r.return_date < $2 GROUP BY r.return_reason ORDER BY returned_units DESC, r.return_reason ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 2
review_cases.reason: REVISE stale required_metric_or_intent: 'top three' conflicts with requested TOP 2 and SQL LIMIT 2. Correct metadata. All three return reasons tie at 13 units, so numerical ranking direction is not distinguishable here.

review_cases.question: Tiếp tục dùng snapshot vừa chọn; xếp hạng top 5 product theo stockout_days giảm dần, tie-break product_id tăng dần.
review_cases.gold_sql: SELECT i.product_id, i.stockout_days FROM commerce.inventory AS i WHERE i.snapshot_date = $1 ORDER BY i.stockout_days DESC, i.product_id ASC LIMIT 5
